stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class): 7,496 first-year applicants, 7,188 admitted, 777 enrolled (about 96% admitted). The Common Data Set PDF text is partly scrambled, so the admission factor checkboxes, test policy boxes, residency and international splits, costs and nonresident aid boxes could not be read; those are not shown. SAT percentiles are for the 58 enrolled first-years who sent SAT scores (7.46%); the ACT row is blank. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (rows with 0% omitted); average GPA 3.22 (100% reporting). The Common Data Set shows 33 nonresident first-time first-year students. Enrollment of 4,867 undergraduates is IPEDS fall 2024.

cds_test_policy.notes: The test policy boxes in the Common Data Set could not be read from the PDF; Salem State's admissions pages state it is test-optional.
